systems.owner: Ministère de la sécurité et de la protection civile

systems.system: Système d'Informations Policières d'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO/WAPIS)
systems.platform: SIPAO/WAPIS, an ECOWAS programme sponsored by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL
systems.owner: Ministère de la sécurité et de la protection civile; memorandum between INTERPOL and the Togolese government signed 14 March 2019
systems.tiers: a first lot of computer equipment, valued at 36 million CFA francs, handed over at the ministry on 5 November 2019; aim stated as interconnecting police, gendarmerie, customs, water and forests and justice to share police information; no unit named

note: No fact: the ministry reports the handover on 5 November 2019 of a new paper custody register, a single-function class, and of a first lot of SIPAO equipment; it says nothing of how units record reports or cases, and describes SIPAO only by its aim, so that system has no class. The page prints no date of its own; the event date is in its text.
